_description: Canonical disaster link semantics for shared links.parquet and embedded relationship fields

triggered_by.note: Hazard-native parent relationship field when a row explicitly references its cause.

triggered.note: Hazard-native child relationship field when a row embeds downstream effects.

earthquake_event_ids.note: Hazard-native related-earthquake list; should not be treated as a direct substitute for the shared link table.

tsunami_event_id.note: Single related tsunami reference on an event row.

tsunami_event_ids.note: Multiple related tsunami references on an event row.

aftershock_count.note: Count summary only; not a canonical edge field.

link_type.note: Hazard-native relationship label when a row also carries embedded relationship ids.
